subject: Acme — Post-call TCO recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T15:07:00-08:00
Subject: Acme — Post-call TCO recap & next steps

Hi Sam / Lena — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap while it's fresh and a proposed set of next steps.

Key pain points you shared:
- Token costs are growing unpredictably as usage spikes (esp. customer chat flows).
- Peak latency during business hours is causing degraded UX for high-concurrency endpoints.
- Budget headroom is limited for Q1; procurement prefers a clear TCO and expected ROI.

What we discussed (high level):
- Typical cost levers: batching, prefix/KV caching, quantization (FP16/INT8) where possible, and reserved capacity (Dedicated) for steady throughput.
- Redwood runtime features that help: automatic request batching, prefix caching for repeated prompts, and routing to lower-cost model variants under heavy load.

Initial TCO framing (illustrative):
- Baseline hosted (no batching/caching): ~$0.35 per 1k tokens => ~ $3,500 per 10M tokens/month.
- With batching (35% effective token-efficiency) + prefix caching on repeat prompts (20% effective reduction for chat history reuse): net ~45% reduction => est. $1,925/month.
- Dedicated / Reserved capacity (committed 1.0x throughput pool) can further reduce unit costs ~20-30% vs hosted after accounting for commit level and utilization => est. $1,350–$1,700/month at 10M tokens with the right commit.

Assumptions to confirm:
1) 10M tokens/month baseline usage (you mentioned 8–12M typical)
2) Average sequence length per request ~ 250 tokens
3) 30% of requests are repeatable (benefit from prefix caching)
4) Target latency SLO: P95 <= 400ms for user-facing queries

Proposed next steps:
1) I attached a simple TCO calculator (redwood-tco-calculator.xlsx) — please populate your exact monthly token distribution and avg lengths.
2) We'll produce a tailored 1-page TCO with two scenarios (hosted w/optims vs Dedicated reserved) for your finance team.
3) Quick follow-up: 30-min call next week to review the populated sheet and procurement timeline.

Recording & materials: demo recording link and calculator are attached.

If you want, I can also run a 2-week pilot with basic caching enabled to show real-time savings on your traffic profile.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Simplified cost (10M tokens/month):
  • Hosted (with batching + caching optims): est $1,900/month
  • Dedicated (reserved 1.0x pool, moderate commit): est $1,350/month (after commit discounts)

I attached the calculator with these illustrative numbers filled in and a brief notes tab explaining the levers. If you want a tighter quote for procurement, we can:
- Run a short, scoped pilot to measure effective batching rates and cache hit % on your traffic (2 weeks)
- Or provide a firm reserved pricing sheet once we know commit level and utilization target.

Can we schedule 30 minutes on Wed 12/2 or Thu 12/3 to review the populated sheet? I'm flexible — share a couple windows and I’ll send a calendar invite.
